summary: AI retirement / vehicle-failure event handler for the player's team during a race. Gated to session type 7 (dword_7C56A4 == 7, dword_7C56A8 != 8) and to events for the player's own team (vehicle id at this+0x4894 matches dword_7C54E8+0x4894). Inserts driver-table entries: initial failure notification (type 41), the retiring opponent's gap (type 1), the leading vehicle's gap (type 2, gated on status this+0x8138 != 2), and final-lap countdown alerts keyed by remaining-laps (types 273 / 272). Lap-time gaps are computed with LapTimeGapCalculation and truncated via CRTFtol.

operations.description: Entry guards: dword_7D0308 nonzero AND flt_7CF3C8 != 0.0 AND session phase dword_7C56A8 != 8 AND session type dword_7C56A4 == 7; otherwise return without processing.
Team filter: proceed only when the player vehicle's team id (dword_7C54E8 + 0x4894) equals this event's team id (this+0x4894).
StructInitWithSentinelValues(v8) initializes the driver-table scratch row.
Initial failure notification: DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v8, 41, this+0x4060, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) then InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v8).

Opponent retirement: v2 = this+0x40D0; when v2 nonzero and LapTimeGapCalculation(v2, v1, &v7, &a1) returns false, compute gap = CRTFtol(v7) if a1 <= 0 else 9999; insert type-1 entry DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v8, 1, this+0x896C, this+0x8130, gap, -1, -2.0, -2.0) then InsertDriverTableEntry.

Leading vehicle: v4 = this+0x40D4; when v4 nonzero, its status this+0x8138 != 2, and LapTimeGapCalculation(v1, v4, &v7, &a1) returns false, compute gap = CRTFtol(v7) if a1 <= 0 else 9999; insert type-2 entry DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v8, 2, this+0x8970, this+0x8134, gap, -1, -2.0, -2.0) then InsertDriverTableEntry.

Switch on v6 (jump table jpt_419B98 / byte_419C18): case 1 -> DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v8, 273, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) + InsertDriverTableEntry; cases 2..12,15,20,25,30,35,40,50 -> DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v8, 272, v6, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) + InsertDriverTableEntry; default -> return.
